card.name: Antipsychotic alternatives not available wording
card.fires_on: The word "not" (or "are") in the stock antipsychotic label phrase "alternative, equally effective, but potentially less harmful treatments are not available or appropriate". Also a comma after "widely varying conditions" and "make" in "insufficient data are available to make".

modes.label: Alternative treatments not available
modes.description: The word "not" or "are" just before "available or appropriate" in the antipsychotic chronic-use statement.
modes.example: alternative, equally effective, but potentially less harmful treatments are<< not>> available or appropriate.

modes.label: Clinical trial rates sentence
modes.description: The comma after "varying conditions" in the clinical trials experience statement.
modes.example: Because clinical trials are conducted under widely varying conditions<<,>> adverse reaction rates observed in the clinical trials

modes.label: Insufficient data to make
modes.description: The verb "make" in "insufficient data are available to make a dosing recommendation".
modes.example: Insufficient data are available to<< make>> a dosing recommendation for patients with Cr

card.plain: It lights up at fixed spots in familiar label sentences, mainly the antipsychotic line about alternative treatments not being available.
